area: Per-geohash derived identities and NIP-19 bech32
derivation: HMAC-SHA256(key = device_seed, msg = utf8(label) || big-endian u32 iteration), iteration starting at 0, transcribed from NostrIdentityBridge.deriveIdentity(forGeohash:). The x-only public key is d*G computed with a pure-python secp256k1 validated against the generator multiples and BIP-340's official signing vectors; npub/nsec are bech32 with hrp "npub" / "nsec" over the 32 raw bytes, validated against the NIP-19 example keys.
note: The iteration counter is appended even on the first attempt: the message is utf8(label) followed by four zero bytes, NOT the bare label. Omitting it produces a different key for every cell and silently breaks identity continuity with bitchat.
